We performed well throughout and won the final match at Cheam. Es Hassan, Andrew Hill, Duncan Thompson, Steve Taylor and Dwaine Patterson were selected to represent Surrey in the National Event.

Below: Andrew Hill (B) gets himself into the perfect position to strike in the Colts' 800m at Tonbridge. He won two events that day and finished the season with an amazing four first places and three seconds in our 1992 club rankings!
In the U15 age group, we again had a winning double from Gavin Jones and Gavin Walsh in the 1500m and also in the U15 we won both pole vault strings thanks to Andrew Hill and Stevie Scott.

Our lucky quartette were Mellisa Simon, Laura Wilson, Andrew Hill and Steve Scott. Apart from meeting the stars of the show and Colin Jackson, they met Florence and Dougal from the Magic Roundabout and Belgrave even got its name in the credits.
